snippet.title: Don’t Starve Together: Console Edition - Launch Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/dont-starve-together-console-edition/

Don’t Starve Together is now on PS5!
Get ready to explore The Constant like never before. With Dual Sense Haptics, smoother performance and faster load times, players have never been more prepared to survive and thrive in Don't Starve Together. PS4 players upgrade free—plus, claim your free Welcome Gift at launch.
